23992557.reason: ELIGIBLE under the registered broad PICO (population is pericarditis — ACUTE first episode OR recurrent — treated to prevent recurrence; the protocol was deliberately revised from a recurrent-only draft), so ICAP is NOT refused for population. It is not POOLED because its recurrence-specific outcome is not extractable from an accessible source: the ICAP abstract (NEJM 2013, PMID 23992557) reports only the composite primary “incessant OR recurrent pericarditis” (20/120 vs 45/120), a DIFFERENT endpoint from our “recurrent pericarditis” outcome; the pure-recurrence component (reported as 11/120 vs 25/120 in the full text per an external audit) is full-text-only and the NEJM full text is NOT open-access (no PMC/EPMC, Europe PMC isOpenAccess=N), so we cannot verify it against a committed source span and do not pool an unverifiable number. Were it poolable it would give k=3, RR ~0.474, excluding the null — consistent with a later randomised-evidence meta (RR 0.48, 0.36–0.63) and with our k=2 point estimate. Recorded as not-extracted (full text not retrievable), not a population refusal.
